passage:
A group of engineers shared free designs for a low-cost wheelchair part online. People in different countries downloaded the design, improved it, and adapted it to local materials.
Students were surprised that invention could be shared instead of sold privately.
Their teacher explained open-source work. Sharing designs can help more people solve problems, but it also requires testing, safety checks, and responsible use.
The wheelchair part showed the power of cooperation across distance.
An idea placed online can travel farther than a product in a box. When knowledge is shared carefully, improvement can come from many hands.
